scientific_scope_status: For qubit depolarization Dλ(ρ)=λρ+(1−λ)I₂Trρ/2 on its full CP interval −1/3≤λ≤1, the ordinary arbitrary-finite-reference quantum mutual-information contraction coefficient is 2λ²/(1+λ). The complete and conditional Umegaki coefficient is 3λ²/(1+2λ); these differ for interior nontrivial λ. For d>2 the retained sources establish bounds and a strict gap, not an exact MI formula. Ordinary MI, complete equal-reference Umegaki, and conditional relative entropy remain different quantities. Higher-dimensional exact MI is not claimed.
